scope: Qualify generated MLEADERSTYLE DXF writer revision boundaries and allocation rollback/retry for the selected profile.

source.kind: deterministic locally-authored in-memory DRW_MLeaderStyle generated during each test run
source.profile: One style with version 2, description, default text, text height, two EED entries, AC1024+ attachment direction and top/bottom attachment fields, and AC1027+ text-extended flag.

implementation.method: For each supported version and encoding, calibrate allocation count, inject failure at every measured allocation, and verify destination-sentinel rollback and full caller field preservation. Retry with the same codec and verify byte-identical output and typed readback. Check pre-AC1021 refusal preserves caller and destination.

validation.directControl: build-gcc/tests/libdxfrw_mleaderstyle_objects_allocation_tests: PASS; 19 ASCII and 18 Binary offsets for each of AC1021, AC1024, AC1027, and AC1032; AC1018 refusal preserves caller and destination

limitations: Generated writer revision and transaction evidence only; no producer interoperability or native MLEADER rendering is qualified.
Only the initialized fields of one MLEADERSTYLE profile are covered; other field combinations and dependency graphs remain open.
No support claim is promoted and no DWG/DXF fixture is committed.
